# Annex C - Variable reference {#sec-annex-c}

This annex lists the shared simulation state, the settings, and the EDEN
module fields. Mission scripts can read any `aee_core_*` variable.

## Simulation state

| Variable | Subsystem | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `biome` | core | Koppen biome code |
| `biomeName` | core | Biome display name |
| `cloudCeiling_m` | atmos | Cloud base height in metres |
| `crossoverTimer` | thermal | Thermal crossover timer |
| `currentAirDensity` | ballistics | Air density in kg/m3 |
| `currentBlowingSnow` | environmental | Blowing snow intensity 0..1 |
| `currentCropDensity` | environmental | Crop density 0..1 |
| `currentDustDevil` | environmental | Dust devil activity 0..1 |
| `currentFireRisk` | environmental | Fire spread risk 0..1 |
| `currentFloodRisk` | environmental | Flash flood risk 0..1 |
| `currentFogDensity` | atmos | Fog density 0..1 |
| `currentFreezingRain` | thermal | Freezing rain 0..1 |
| `currentGusts` | atmos | Gust speed in m/s |
| `currentHumidity` | atmos | Relative humidity percent |
| `currentHypothermiaRisk` | thermal | Hypothermia risk 0..1 |
| `currentIcingSeverity` | atmos | Airframe icing 0..1 |
| `currentLightningRisk` | atmos | Lightning risk 0..1 |
| `currentPressure` | atmos | Barometric pressure in hPa |
| `currentPressureTrend` | atmos | Pressure trend |
| `currentSandstorm` | environmental | Sandstorm intensity 0..1 |
| `currentTemperature` | thermal | Air temperature in C |
| `currentTideDescription` | maritime | Tide description |
| `currentTideOffset_m` | maritime | Tide offset in metres |
| `currentTurbulence` | atmos | Turbulence 0..1 |
| `currentUVIndex` | physiology | UV index |
| `currentWaterLevel` | mobility | River water level |
| `currentWaterTemperature` | thermal | Water temperature in C |
| `currentWBGT` | thermal | Wet bulb globe temperature in C |
| `currentWeatherForecast` | atmos | Weather forecast text |
| `currentWind` | atmos | Wind vector |
| `currentWindDir` | atmos | Wind direction in degrees |
| `dustSuppression` | environmental | Dust suppression 0..1 |
| `groundState` | mobility | Ground state |
| `magneticDeclinationDeg` | maritime | Magnetic declination |
| `moduleBiomeOverride` | core | Module biome override |
| `moduleTempOffset` | core | Module temperature offset |
| `moduleWindMultiplier` | core | Module wind multiplier |
| `overcast` | core | Engine overcast |
| `pressureReading1` | atmos | Pressure reading 1 |
| `pressureReading2` | atmos | Pressure reading 2 |
| `rainAccum` | core | Rain accumulation |
| `seaStateBeaufort` | maritime | Sea state on the Beaufort scale |
| `seaStateCurrent` | maritime | Sea state current |
| `seaStateDescription` | maritime | Sea state description |
| `snowDepth_m` | environmental | Snow depth in metres |
| `soilMoisture` | core | Soil moisture 0..1 |
| `surfaceTemperature` | thermal | Surface temperature in C |
| `thermalCrossoverActive` | thermal | Thermal crossover flag |
| `updateInterval` | core | Update interval in seconds |
| `vehicleHeatShimmerIntensity` | optics | Heat shimmer 0..1 |
| `waveHeight_m` | maritime | Wave height in metres |

## Settings

26 settings register under the "AEE Core" category in the CBA settings
interface. They live in `addons/core/initSettings.inc.sqf` and use
`CBA_fnc_addSetting`. Titles and descriptions come from the core
stringtable.

## EDEN module

The module AEE Environment Config exposes these fields:

| Field | Type | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biomeOverride` | STRING | empty | Force a Koppen biome |
| `tempOffset` | NUMBER | 0 | Temperature offset in C |
| `precipBias` | NUMBER | 1 | Rain accumulation multiplier |
| `windMultiplier` | NUMBER | 1 | Wind multiplier |
| `updateInterval` | NUMBER | 5 | Update interval in seconds |
